items.title: AMD也有自己的中国问题​ | AMD | 英伟达 | 浪潮信息 | 浪潮信息 Systems | Aivres | Kaytus | Maginfra | 实体清单 | 出口管制 | BIOS固件
items.brief_zh: 报告称，浪潮信息被列入实体清单后，其服务器 BIOS 仍在跟进 AMD 的新版固件，AMD 与中国相关服务器网络、授权收益、封测和贷款的联系比外界想的更深；但这些证据只是线索，不能证明违规。
items.background_zh: 2026年10月12日英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去首席执行官职务，部分投资者把 AMD 看成更“干净”的替代选择。一周后，对冲基金 Hunterbrook 发布 AMD 做空报告，指出 AMD 同样绕不开中国。主播大飞逐条梳理了报告中的证据。
items.conclusion_zh: 主播认为，这些内容不构成投资判断，也不等于监管机构已认定违规；现在的路径可能完全合规，但不代表在未来规则下不变。出口管制正从单颗芯片延伸到软件更新、股权关系、海外数据中心和后端封测。后续可以追踪海运和最终客户是否更透明、海光账目中的“J公司”能否确认，以及1亿美元贷款如何处理。留下的开放问题是：当监管穿透整条供应链，芯片公司不只要流程合规，整个合作网络也要经得起核查。
items.brief_en: A short-seller report says AMD firmware kept flowing into Inspur servers after Inspur's Entity List listing, and that AMD's ties to China run through related server firms, licensing income, packaging and a loan. The host stresses that these are leads and do not prove a violation.
items.background_en: On 12 October 2026 Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang would step down as CEO, and some investors saw AMD as a cleaner alternative. A week later the hedge fund Hunterbrook published a short report on AMD, arguing that AMD is also tied to China. The host, Da Fei, goes through the evidence in the report.
items.conclusion_en: The host says the content is not investment advice and does not mean regulators have found a violation. Current arrangements may be fully compliant, but that does not mean they stay so under future rules. Export controls are moving from single chips to software updates, ownership ties, overseas data centres and back-end packaging. Items to follow are clearer shipping and end-customer data, whether Company J in Hygon's accounts is confirmed, and what happens to the US$100 million loan. The open question is how a chipmaker can show that its whole partner network, and not only its paperwork, will withstand scrutiny.
points_zh: 浪潮信息在被列入实体清单后，服务器 BIOS 里仍持续出现 AMD 的新版固件。浪潮信息2025年3月25日被列入清单，向其出口受 EAR 约束的产品、软件和技术需要许可证，审查政策是推定拒绝。此后至少三款服务器型号的 BIOS 更新了六个版本的 AMD 固件；在 AMD 发布日期可查的五个版本中，浪潮信息的跟进间隔为25到61天。2025年10月的一次更新还包含了一个到2026年2月才公开披露的漏洞的修复。这说明浪潮信息的软件仍在跟随新版本，但时间上的接近只是相关性，不能证明是谁提供了更新，也不能推出 AMD 知情或授权。

同样的固件出现在浪潮信息、济南的 Maginfra、新加坡的 Kaytus 和加州的 Aivres 四家的下载站上，这几家公司在股权上有关联。一份32MB 固件被拆成8192个4K片段，8187个一致，相似度99.94%。Maginfra 2025年2月在济南注册，文件里留有浪潮信息客户体验计划的文字和内部产品编号。Kaytus 经审计的2025年账目写明最终控股公司是浪潮信息，货物几乎全部向关联方采购，2025年向浪潮信息支付了1.64亿美元的推荐费。Aivres 在2023年5月前叫 Inspur Systems；浪潮信息的年报曾将其列为子公司，但它在 HPE 专利案中称自己由 Kater Group Limited 全资拥有，案件和解，法院没有裁定所有权。AMD 官网把 Aivres 列为合作伙伴，其产品可搭载 MI300X 或 MI325X。股权链条能连起来，但法律含义还要看完整记录。

海关记录显示有大量零件持续运往 Aivres，但看不出最终装了什么芯片、成品去了哪里。浪潮信息被列入清单以来，共有209批服务器部件从中国运到 Aivres，总重超过2000公吨，截至2026年10月的12个月比前12个月增加178%，提单仍用浪潮信息的域名邮箱。运到的主要是不带芯片的主板、机箱、电源、散热器和占位内存，通常是先交裸机、再在最终组装环节装处理器。Aivres 的一名运营经理说公司向中国和周边国家发了很多货，但不透露地点，公司没有回应最终所有者和成品流向的问题。另有报道称，Aivres 2024年4月至2026年2月从美国向东南亚出口至少56亿美元产品，其中超过30亿美元是搭载英伟达 Blackwell 芯片的计算机；这些记录不能代替 AMD 芯片去向的证明。

规则正在向关联公司和第三国扩展，这是这些股权关系变得重要的原因。2025年9月发布的关联公司规则（被清单企业直接或间接持股至少50%的外国实体也受限）随后暂停，2026年10月9日暂停期延长到2027年1月10日。若不再延期且浪潮信息仍全资持有 Kaytus 或 Aivres，它们可能继承同样的限制。另外，BIS 新规要求向新加坡、马来西亚、印度尼西亚、泰国和巴西出口先进 AI 芯片及服务器需要许可证，符合条件的美国总部买家及其子公司可例外。AMD 2025年仅向新加坡客户开票42.8亿美元，占总营收12.4%（2023财年为22.3亿美元），但开票地不等于最终目的地，实际影响要看买家总部、最终用户等条件。

AMD 与被列入清单的海光之间存在值得追问的授权款项线索。AMD 持有两家成都合资企业51%和30%的股权，合作方海光2019年被列入实体清单。AMD 2025年记录了6700万美元授权收益，同比增长40%。海光账目2025年向“J公司”记录了5.85亿元人民币的费用，2021年约1.097亿元与招股书中归属 AMD 的数字吻合；按海光账目推算2021至2025年付款约2.7亿美元，AMD 同期披露的授权收入约2.63亿美元。双方都没有确认 J 公司就是 AMD。即使有关，也可能是清单前已授权技术的特许权使用费，实体清单限制的是出口，并不禁止收款，所以付款本身不是违规证据。另外，AMD 2026年2月的 InfiniBand 服务器目录里有一款机器，是被列入清单的 Suzhou Summa Technology 的别名，Summa 与浪潮信息同日被列入。

中国业务与 AMD 的销售、封测和融资都交织在一起，不容易剥离。2025财年 AMD 向中国内地和香港客户开票77.5亿美元，占总营收22.4%；按客户总部口径的对应占比是9.1%，两个口径不同，不能直接相减。2025年4月 MI308 受许可要求限制后，AMD 计提约8亿美元库存及相关费用。封测方面，通富微电持股85%的两家合资企业承担 AMD 大部分芯片的封装测试（通富文件称处理 AMD 相关产品80%以上的后端封测），AMD 持有其余15%，2025年采购约20亿美元服务。AMD 2024年10月还向其中一家提供1亿美元一年期贷款，展期到2026年10月16日，到期后文件仍把这1亿美元列为截至2026年9月底未偿还，且没有新的到期日。2026年前9个月 AMD 向这些合资方采购18亿美元（上年同期15亿美元），9月末欠款6.06亿美元。
这些证据能核实的部分和不能核实的部分要分开看。固件版本、时间序列和99.94%的文件相似度有明确方法；Kaytus 的股权有审计账目、年报和法院文件支持。无法确认的是代码如何到达浪潮信息、AMD 或其他供应商是否持有许可证，以及许可证是否合规。此外，调查方关联的基金在2026年10月19日持有 AMD 空头头寸，同时持有一篮子可比证券的多头，存在利益冲突。
points_en: Inspur's server BIOS kept receiving new AMD firmware after Inspur joined the Entity List. Inspur was listed on 25 March 2025, and exports of EAR-controlled items, software and technology to it need a licence, with a presumption of denial. At least three server models received six AMD firmware versions after that date. For the five versions with a known AMD release date, Inspur followed within 25 to 61 days. An October 2025 update also contained a fix for a flaw that was disclosed only in February 2026. This shows Inspur's software still tracks new versions. The timing is only a correlation, and it does not show who supplied the updates or that AMD knew or authorised them.

The same firmware appears on the download sites of four related companies: Inspur, Maginfra in Jinan, Kaytus in Singapore and Aivres in California. A 32 MB firmware image was split into 8,192 blocks of 4 KB, and 8,187 matched, a similarity of 99.94%. Maginfra was registered in Jinan in February 2025 and its files keep text about Inspur's customer experience programme and Inspur internal product codes. Kaytus's audited 2025 accounts name Inspur as the ultimate parent. Almost all its goods come from related parties, and it paid Inspur US$164 million in referral fees in 2025. Aivres was called Inspur Systems until May 2023, and an Inspur annual report once listed it as a subsidiary. In a patent case with HPE, however, Aivres said it is wholly owned by Kater Group Limited. The case settled and the court did not rule on ownership. AMD's website lists Aivres as a partner, and its products can carry MI300X or MI325X accelerators. The records link the firms in one ownership chain, but their legal meaning depends on the full filings.

Customs records show a steady flow of parts to Aivres, but not which chips were installed or where finished servers went. Since the Inspur listing, 209 shipments of server parts have gone from China to Aivres, weighing over 2,000 tonnes. Volume in the 12 months to October 2026 was 178% higher than in the prior 12 months, and the bills of lading still use an Inspur-domain email. The goods are mostly boards without chips, chassis, power supplies, heat sinks and placeholder memory. The usual practice is to ship bare systems and add processors, memory and drives at final assembly. A person who described themselves as Aivres's operations manager said the company ships a lot to China and nearby countries but would not name locations. The company did not answer questions about its ultimate owner or whether finished systems go to China-based customers. Separate reporting says Aivres exported at least US$5.6 billion of technology products from the US to Southeast Asia between April 2024 and February 2026, over US$3 billion of it computers with Nvidia Blackwell chips. Those records do not prove where AMD chips went.

Rules are extending to affiliates and third countries, which is why the ownership links matter. An affiliates rule from September 2025 would restrict foreign entities that a listed company owns at least 50% of, directly or indirectly. It was suspended, and on 9 October 2026 the suspension was extended to 10 January 2027. If it is not extended again and Inspur still wholly owns Kaytus or Aivres, they could inherit Inspur's restrictions. Separately, a new BIS rule requires licences for exports of advanced AI chips and servers to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil, with an exception for US-headquartered buyers and their subsidiaries. AMD billed Singapore customers US$4.28 billion in 2025, or 12.4% of revenue, against US$2.23 billion in fiscal 2023. The billing address is not the final destination, so the real effect depends on buyer headquarters, end users and the goods involved.

There is a lead on licensing payments between AMD and Hygon, which is on the Entity List. AMD holds 51% and 30% of two Chengdu joint ventures, and its partner Hygon was listed in 2019. AMD booked US$67 million of licensing revenue in 2025, up 40%. Hygon's accounts show RMB 585 million in fees to a party called Company J in 2025. The 2021 figure of about RMB 109.7 million matches the amount the prospectus attributes to AMD. Hygon's accounts imply payments of about US$270 million over 2021 to 2025, and AMD disclosed about US$263 million of licensing revenue over the same period. Neither side has confirmed that Company J is AMD. Even if it is, the payments may be royalties on technology licensed before the listing. The Entity List limits exports to listed firms and does not bar taking payments from them, so the payments are not evidence of a violation. In addition, AMD's February 2026 InfiniBand server catalogue includes a machine that the Entity List records as an alias of Suzhou Summa Technology, which was listed with Inspur on the same day.

China is woven into AMD's sales, packaging and financing, so it is hard to separate. In fiscal 2025 AMD billed mainland China and Hong Kong customers US$7.75 billion, or 22.4% of revenue. By customer headquarters the share is 9.1%. The two bases differ, so they cannot be subtracted. After the April 2025 licence requirement on the MI308, AMD took a charge of about US$800 million for inventory and related costs. For packaging, two joint ventures that TFME owns 85% of handle most of AMD's chip assembly and testing, and TFME's filings say they handle over 80% of AMD's back-end work. AMD owns the other 15% and bought about US$2 billion of services from them in 2025. In October 2024 AMD also lent US$100 million for one year to one of them. The loan was extended to 16 October 2026, and the filings still show the US$100 million as outstanding at the end of September 2026 with no new due date. In the first nine months of 2026 AMD bought US$1.8 billion from these partners, against US$1.5 billion a year earlier, and owed them US$606 million at the end of September.

The report's verifiable and unverifiable parts need to be kept apart. The firmware versions, the timing and the 99.94% similarity come from a clear method. Kaytus's ownership is supported by audited accounts, annual reports and court filings. It is not confirmed how the code reached Inspur, whether AMD or other suppliers hold licences, or whether any licences are in compliance. The fund linked to the investigators held a short position in AMD on 19 October 2026 and long positions in a basket of comparable stocks, which is a conflict of interest.

items.title: 每个拥抱金融泡沫的人，都坚信自己能全身而退​ | 金融泡沫 | AI泡沫 | 金融投机史 | 爱德华·钱塞勒 | 金融狂热 | 互联网泡沫 | 道德风险 | 动量投资 | 被动投资 | 迷因股
items.brief_zh: 爱德华·钱塞勒认为，400年的金融狂热有一套反复出现的配方，当下的AI热潮几乎全部具备，可能是历次投资热潮中最危险的一次，他建议普通人避开过度集中的被动指数投资。
items.background_zh: 嘉宾爱德华·钱塞勒（视频转写写作“钱赛乐”）是《金融投机史》（1999年出版）的作者，做过多年投资，也是历史学出身。他在一档播客访谈中，把郁金香狂热、南海泡沫、铁路泡沫、日本泡沫和互联网泡沫，与当前的AI热潮逐项对照。
items.conclusion_zh: 钱塞勒认为现在的局面看起来、叫起来都像泡沫，就是泡沫，但他不预测破裂时点，也承认做投资的人总会被证明判断错过。他给听众最重要的建议是避开被动或指数投资，因为指数过于集中在最具投机性的主题上，应把钱交给真正做价值判断的人；若不担心政府最终偿付能力，减一些股票仓位、多配债券是合理的。
items.brief_en: Edward Chancellor argues that 400 years of financial manias follow a repeating recipe, that the current AI boom has nearly all of it and may be the most dangerous boom yet, and that ordinary investors should avoid heavily concentrated passive index funds.
items.background_en: The guest, Edward Chancellor (spelled "钱赛乐" in the transcript), wrote Devil Take the Hindmost (1999), has worked in investing for years and trained as a historian. In a podcast interview he compared tulip mania, the South Sea Bubble, the railway bubble, the Japanese bubble and the dot-com bubble with the current AI boom.
items.conclusion_en: Chancellor says the situation looks and sounds like a bubble, so it is one, but he does not predict when it will burst and admits that investors are often proven wrong. His main advice is to avoid passive or index investing, because indexes are too concentrated in the most speculative themes, and to give money to investors who actually judge fair value. If one is not worried about the government's solvency, he says it is reasonable to cut some equity exposure and hold more bonds.
points_zh: 他把投机狂热看作发生在经济领域的社会运动，泡沫的核心是多数人从投资者变成了赌徒。引用《客户的游艇在哪里》的说法：投机是想把一点钱变成一大笔钱，多半不成功；投资是设法不让一大笔钱变成一点钱。他提到，今天散户交易平台上的交易量巨大，很多人自以为在投资，其实是在赌或投机。

泡沫有一套反复出现的配方：低利率、杠杆、资本流入、通信提速，外加救世主式的领袖。荷兰郁金香狂热时利率低、外资涌入，还出现了期货，最后因期货价格与现货脱节而自行崩盘。通信越快，投机传播越快，从报纸、电报到Reddit的WallStreetBets都是如此。南海泡沫的核心人物约翰·布伦特（转写为“布劳特”）有夸张的救世主做派，还通过银行给买股票的人提供杠杆，并行贿。他把黄仁勋、Dario Amodei、Sam Altman和Elon Musk放在同类对照里，说救世主式领袖会让狂热运转更有效率，但往往最后越过界限。

博傻心态和道德风险让人相信自己能全身而退。南海泡沫时有银行家说“既然世人都疯了，我们也得跟着学几分”，结果赔光，并事后找替罪羊。日本1980年代的人相信政府不会让股价下跌、银行大到不能倒，泡沫仍然破了，股市花了30多年才恢复。中国房地产也有“北京不会让泡沫破”的说法，直到2020年末三道红线出台。他认为这次与历史的最大不同是政府财政托底能力：英国、美国、法国依赖外国借款，国际投资净头寸大幅为负，而1920年代和1999到2000年美国有财政盈余。

他认为大家都在讨论泡沫，并不意味着泡沫马上破。铁路泡沫时人人都说是泡沫，照样破了，当时对铁路的兴奋（比如带来世界和平）与今天对AI的说法很像，还有大量重复建设：伦敦到彼得伯勒修了三条线，利兹到曼彻斯特也是三条线。他提到，有人估算未来五年数据基础设施和AI投资可能达到15万亿美元，比铁路狂热还大一点。动量可以非常强，动量因子在美国的回测可追溯到1920年代，但他也看到一项研究称1995到2015年做动量赚不到钱。

他认为AI热潮可能是历次中最危险的一次，因为技术路线不确定，真正的赢家要等泡沫破裂后才浮现。英伟达GPU占主导，但谷歌和博通在做TPU，中国也有竞争产品；也有人认为未来会转向能在办公室甚至手机上跑的小模型，到时不需要那么多芯片。Anthropic和OpenAI的前沿模型在被中国开源模型抢份额，有说法称后者能做到95%的效果、成本只有2%。互联网泡沫时的经验是，亚马逊股价当时也跌了约95%，谷歌还没上市，Facebook还没成立，真正的赢家后来才出现。他认为独立数据中心供应商可能像当年的接入商一样变成同质化生意。

他认为“万物泡沫”特征现在齐备，并以资金趋紧作为泡沫破裂的头号特征，但不预测时点。他列举：SPAC完成了有史以来最大的IPO，他视为史上最大的迷因股；城堡证券数据显示2026年夏天美股成交量超过2021年峰值；Robinhood客户数量是过去的好几倍；预测博彩平台转向永续期货，杠杆可达100到200倍；还有追踪英伟达等的3倍杠杆ETF；韩国散户加杠杆炒半导体股，总理公开支持。历史上，美联储1928年加息后1929年崩盘，日本银行1989年加息，美联储1999到2000年加息，2004年加息后美国房地产泡沫破裂。眼下利率比五年前高很多，通胀保值债券实际收益率不错，股票风险溢价几乎没有，1999到2000年该收益率曾达4.5%。
points_en: He sees speculative manias as social movements that happen in the economy. The core of a bubble is that most people stop being investors and become gamblers. He cites a line from the book Where Are the Customers' Yachts?: speculation tries to turn a little money into a lot and mostly fails, while investing tries to keep a lot of money from becoming a little. He notes that volumes on retail trading platforms are huge, and many people who think they are investing are gambling or speculating.

Bubbles share a recurring recipe: low interest rates, leverage, capital inflows, faster communication and often a messianic leader. In the Dutch tulip mania, rates were low, foreign capital flowed in and a futures market appeared. The bubble collapsed on its own when futures prices detached from spot prices. Faster communication speeds up speculation, from newspapers and the telegraph to Reddit's WallStreetBets. The South Sea figure John Blunt ("布劳特" in the transcript) had a messianic manner, gave leverage to share buyers through his bank and bribed officials. Chancellor puts Jensen Huang, Dario Amodei, Sam Altman and Elon Musk in a similar position. He says such leaders make a mania run more efficiently, but they often overstep in the end.

The belief that one can exit in time, together with moral hazard, runs through these episodes. During the South Sea Bubble a banker said that since the world had gone mad, they should follow a little. He lost everything and then blamed others. In 1980s Japan people believed the government would not let stocks fall and that banks were too big to fail, yet the bubble burst and stocks took over 30 years to recover. Chinese property had a similar belief that Beijing would not let the bubble pop, until the Three Red Lines in late 2020. He says the biggest difference this time is the state's fiscal backing. The UK, the US and France rely on foreign borrowing and have sharply negative net international investment positions. The US had surpluses in the 1920s and in 1999 and 2000.

He says that wide discussion of a bubble does not mean it will burst soon. In the 1840s railway bubble everyone said it was a bubble and it still burst. The excitement then, such as the claim that railways would bring world peace, resembles talk about AI today. There was also duplication: three lines from London to Peterborough and three from Leeds to Manchester. He mentions an estimate that data infrastructure and AI investment could reach 15 trillion dollars over the next five years, slightly more than the railway mania. Momentum can be very strong. He notes that a momentum factor shows excess returns in US backtests going back to the 1920s, but he has seen one study finding no profit from momentum between 1995 and 2015.

He thinks the AI boom may be the most dangerous of all, because the technology path is uncertain and the real winners will only appear after the bubble bursts. Nvidia's GPUs dominate, but Google and Broadcom make TPUs and China has competing products. Some expect a shift to small models that run in an office or on a phone, which would need far fewer chips. Frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI are losing share to Chinese open-source models, with one claim of 95% of the performance at 2% of the cost. In the dot-com bubble, Amazon also fell about 95%, Google was not yet listed and Facebook did not exist. The real winners came later. He suggests independent data center providers may become a commodity business like the access providers of that time.

He says the signs of an "everything bubble" are now all present, and that tight money is the main sign that a speculative bubble is about to burst, though he does not predict timing. He lists these signs: a SPAC completed the largest IPO ever, which he sees as the biggest meme stock in history; Citadel Securities data shows US equity volume in summer 2026 above the 2021 peak; Robinhood has several times more customers than before; prediction-betting platforms have moved to perpetual futures with leverage of 100 to 200 times; and there are 3x leveraged ETFs on Nvidia and others. In South Korea, retail investors use leverage on semiconductor stocks and the prime minister openly supports them. Historically, bubbles burst after rate rises: the Fed raised rates from 1928 before the 1929 crash, the Bank of Japan raised in 1989, the Fed raised in 1999 and 2000, and the US housing bubble burst after the Fed raised rates from 2004. Rates are now much higher than five years ago, inflation-protected bonds yield well, and the equity risk premium is almost gone. He notes that the real yield on these bonds was 4.5% in 1999 and 2000.

items.title: 我用纯代码做动画，美术风格不再靠抽卡
items.brief_zh: 作者做了一套叫 Montage 的 Harness（三个 skill 加一份项目规则），用 12 个预设美术风格兜底，让纯代码做出的动画风格稳定，不再靠抽卡。
items.background_zh: 作者已经能用代码直接做出动画，不用任何视频生成模型。但画面效果取决于提示词写得是否细致专业，新手的结果接近抽卡：第一次好看，下一次可能就一般。垫图也不稳定，同一张参考图每次被理解的结果都不同。所以他想把风格固定下来，稳定输出。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，自己搭建纯代码做视频的 Harness 需要三个 skill（采访、风格、修改）加一份项目规则。模型会越来越强，流程上要操心的事会越来越少，真正值得多花时间的是剧本、创意和审美。
items.brief_en: The author built a harness called Montage (three skills plus a set of project rules) that uses 12 preset art styles as a fallback, so animation made purely with code keeps a stable style and no longer depends on luck.
items.background_en: The author already makes animation directly with code, without any video generation model. The result still depends on how detailed and professional the prompt is, so a beginner's output is close to a lottery: the first try looks good and the next may not. Reference images are also unstable, because the model reads the same image differently each time. He wanted a way to fix the style and get steady output.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that a harness for making video purely with code needs three skills (interview, style and revision) plus a set of project rules. Models will keep improving and leave less to manage in the process, so the things worth more time are the script, the creative idea and the aesthetics.
points_zh: Montage 由三个 skill 和一份项目规则组成，分工明确。interview 负责采访，根据你的描述生成问题，帮你理清思路并写成稿子。style 负责风格，存放 12 个预设。revision 负责修改，先问清楚修改意见，列成清单再由你确认。项目规则把需求确认、风格确认、视频生成、剪辑和修改串成一条工作流。作者建议把精力多放在采访和选风格上，因为这两步改起来很快，而视频生成和后续修改每次渲染要十几分钟到一两个小时。

12 个预设风格是兜底，不是上限。预设有纸雕立体书、水墨、彩色玻璃一类的传统风格，也有线框、粒子点云这样的数字风格，都是用代码渲染的，同一座灯塔场景只换风格。选风格时，AI 会从预设里挑两三个，附上预览图，并说明各自为什么适合、有什么问题。例如粒子点云配色失控会变成蓝紫发光的典型 AI 味；墨比乌斯线描里光点不会发光；1-bit 风格只有两种颜色，做不出金色晨光。作者强调要看预览图而不是只看文字描述，也要重视 AI 提前预警的问题。

作者对视频生成和剪辑这一步故意没写任何 skill。他认为 Harness 里的每个部件都隐含一个“模型做不到”的假设，而模型在变强，假设会过时，硬性规定技术路线反而会限制模型。项目规则里只写了两条模型自己发现不了的问题：逐帧渲染时检查是否空白帧（浏览器图形上下文可能丢失，后面全是空白帧且不报错），以及合成配音前检查多音字读法（他之前有一条片子把“斗”读成了“斗争”的斗）。他的原则是规则里只写模型不知道的事。常用的代码做视频技术有四种：Canvas 2D、Three.js、shader 和 Blender，一条片子常混用多种。

实测案例《小小探测车》：从发出第一句话到拿到第二版共 2 小时 36 分钟，其中前两步不到 14 分钟，其余两个多小时主要花在生成和渲染上。流程是：采访问了 8 个问题，约 3 分钟写出 41 秒、六段的稿子；选了粒子点云风格；GPT 5.2 用 Three.js 全程用代码完成，不用贴图和现成 3D 模型，第一版 42 秒半、20 个镜头。第一版后他提了两条修改意见（去掉左下角日志字幕，修小车头部和眼睛的穿模），经过六个问题的追问后列出五条清单，25 分钟后出了第二版。作者共确认三次、点选十几次，模型输出约 65 万 token。他提修改意见的习惯是：只说看到的现象，说清范围，并说明满意、不能动的地方。
作者认为这条片子美术风格令人满意，但剧情偏平，原因在他自己没有提前准备剧本，AI 只是顺着他给的无冲突的故事去补。他建议准备剧本时至少想清楚四件事：有没有冲突、有没有意外或反转、情绪有没有起伏、有没有让人眼前一亮的地方。

什么时候用代码，什么时候用视频生成模型，作者只看两点：镜头里有没有表演，以及场景用代码搭建的成本高不高。适合代码的有五类：产品，程序生成的场景（地形、星球、天空、海面），结构简单的角色，风格化动画，图解演示和片头包装。他也说代码并不只能做风格化画面，他之前用代码做过讲太和殿的片子，琉璃瓦、红柱、汉白玉台阶都是渲染出来的。适合视频生成模型的也有五类：真人对白和表情特写，两个以上角色的对手戏，人和动物的自然动作，元素极多的场景（热闹街道、一桌菜、风中树林、动物群），头发和衣料这类随身体抖动的细节。两种方式可以结合。

Codex 也能用这套 Harness 做视频，作者展示了深海沙丁鱼群和马里奥的片段，但认为 Codex 在视频创作上的自主性略差，特点是指哪打哪，所以要把画面描述清楚。添加新风格只需两步：用固定的测试场景（海峡上的一座灯塔），让模型用代码按该风格渲染一帧。他演示了加入第 13 个风格“彩色玻璃花窗”，参考图是 Tiffany 工作室约 1990 年的作品。这次一次生成、未做细节调整，他提醒如果风格还原不了，之后做视频时模型就只能降级用替代方案，所以不如一开始就把预设做到位。
points_en: Montage has three skills and one set of project rules, each with a clear job. The interview skill generates questions from your description and helps you turn your ideas into a script. The style skill stores the 12 presets. The revision skill asks about your changes, lists them and waits for your confirmation. The project rules link requirement checking, style selection, video generation, editing and revision into one workflow. The author advises spending most effort on the interview and style steps, because they are quick to change, while each render for generation or revision takes from over ten minutes to one or two hours.

The 12 presets are a safety net, not a limit. They include traditional styles such as paper-cut pop-up book, ink wash and stained glass, and digital styles such as wireframe and particle cloud. All are rendered with code, and each shows the same lighthouse scene in a different style. When you choose a style, the AI picks two or three presets, shows preview images and explains why each fits and what its problems are. For example, particle cloud can drift into a blue-purple glow that looks typical of AI. In Moebius line art, light points do not glow. The 1-bit style has only two colours, so it cannot produce the golden light in the script. The author says to look at the previews, not just the text descriptions, and to take the AI's warnings seriously.

The author deliberately wrote no skill for video generation and editing. He argues that every part of a harness carries an assumption that the model cannot do something, that models keep improving, and that those assumptions go out of date. Fixing the technical route would also limit the model. The project rules contain only two problems the model cannot detect by itself. One is checking each rendered frame for blank output, because the browser graphics context can be lost and every later frame comes out blank without any error. The other is checking the reading of polyphonic characters before the voice-over is made. In an earlier video, 斗 was read as in 斗争. His principle is to tell the model only what it does not already know. He lists four common code techniques for video: Canvas 2D, Three.js, shaders and Blender. One video often mixes several.

The test case was the video 小小探测车 (Little Probe Rover). From his first message to the second version took 2 hours 36 minutes. The first two steps took under 14 minutes, and most of the remaining time went on generation and rendering. The interview asked 8 questions and produced a 41-second script in six sections in about 3 minutes. He chose the particle cloud style. GPT 5.2 then built the video entirely in code with Three.js, with no textures or ready-made 3D models. The first version ran 42.5 seconds with 20 shots. He then gave two revision notes: remove the log-style captions at the lower left, and fix clipping in the rover's head and eye. After six follow-up questions the model listed five changes, and the second version arrived 25 minutes later. He confirmed three times, made a dozen or so clicks, and the model produced about 650,000 tokens. His habit for revision notes is to describe only what he sees, state the scope, and say what he is happy with and must not change.

The author was satisfied with the art style of this video but found the plot flat. He says the cause was himself: he had not prepared a script, and the AI only filled in details on a story that had no conflict. He suggests thinking through at least four things when preparing a script: whether there is conflict, whether there is a surprise or twist, whether the emotion rises and falls, and whether there is a moment that stands out.

To choose between code and a video generation model, the author looks at two things: whether the shot needs acting, and whether the scene is expensive to build in code. Five types suit code: products, procedurally generated scenes (terrain, planets, sky, sea), simple characters, stylised animation, and diagrams or title sequences. He adds that code is not limited to stylised images. In an earlier video on the Hall of Supreme Harmony he rendered glazed tiles, red columns and white marble steps with code. Five types suit a video model: live-action dialogue and facial close-ups, scenes with two or more characters acting together, natural movement of people and animals, scenes with very many objects (a busy street, a table of food, trees in wind, animal herds), and details such as hair and cloth that move with the body. The two methods can be combined.

The author says Codex can also use the harness. He showed a deep-sea sardine school and a Mario clip, but found Codex somewhat less autonomous for video work: it does what it is told, so the visuals must be described clearly. Adding a new style takes two steps: fix a test scene (a lighthouse on a strait) and have the model render one frame in that style with code. He demonstrated adding a 13th style, stained glass window, with a reference image from a Tiffany studio work from around 1990. The result came from a single generation with no refinement. He warns that if a style cannot be reproduced well, the model will later fall back to a weaker substitute when making videos, so the preset should be done properly first.

items.title: Opus just lost to the last company you'd expect...
items.brief_zh: Google 发布的中档模型 Gemini 4 Neon 在多项基准上超过了三周前发布的旗舰 Carbon，也在 Google 自己挑选的对比中领先 Opus 5.5，但这些基准由 Google 挑选，视频作者认为 Neon 是 Google 重新开始出货的一个好信号，画 3D 马的表现仍不如 Anthropic。
items.background_zh: Fireship 的 Code Report 在 2026 年 11 月 23 日这期里，讨论上周 Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon。这是 Gemini 4 系列七周内的第四个模型，而且同一周 AI 圈发生了很多事，所以很容易被忽略。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者认为 Neon 是 Google 向正确方向迈出的一步，虽然在 3D 马上仍落后于 Anthropic，但 Google 重新开始出货是好事。
items.brief_en: Google's mid-tier Gemini 4 Neon beats its three-week-old flagship Carbon on several benchmarks and leads Opus 5.5 on Google's own comparisons, but the author notes the benchmarks are Google's picks and Neon still trails Anthropic on his 3D horse test.
items.background_en: On the 23rd of November 2026, Fireship's Code Report covers Google's release of Gemini 4 Neon last week. It is the fourth Gemini 4 model in seven weeks, and it landed in a week with a lot of other AI news.
items.conclusion_en: The author sees Neon as a step in the right direction for Google. It still trails Anthropic on the 3D horse test, but he is glad to see Google shipping again.
points_zh: Neon 是面向编码 agent、知识工作和科学的中档模型，由 Gemini 4 Carbon 改造而来，规格如下。它支持文本、图像、音频和视频输入，上下文窗口为 100 万 token，价格约为每百万输入 token 3 美元、输出 15 美元。另有一个只给受信任网络防御者使用的 cyber 版本，普通用户用不了。视频还说，到 12 月 1 日之前，它是 Gemini 4 系列里最贵的模型。

基准成绩很好，但视频提醒这些是 Google 自己挑的。在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上，Neon 得 61 分，比 Carbon 高 1 分，总排名第三，排在 Claude Fable 5.2 和 GPT 6.2 Astra 之后。在其编码 agent 指数上，它超过 Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.2，成本约为一半。它还在 Riemann 相关的高难度数学基准上排第一。作者指出，模型卡里的对比表只放了 Opus 5.5 和 GPT 6.2 Soul 这两个 Neon 恰好能赢的模型，没有放 Fable 和 Astra。他还说，黎曼猜想据称在周五被证明，出力的是 Anthropic 的 Claude 而不是 Neon，这个证明尚待验证，并且有一个竞争的人类证明。

速度方面表现不一。Neon 每秒输出约 106 个 token，接近 Carbon 的两倍。但 Artificial Analysis 仍把它标为极慢，测试中消耗了 2.83 亿个 token，是中位数的四倍多。作者个人的使用体验是，Neon 明显比大多数其他模型快。他还推荐在 Google 的 Antigravity IDE 里用它，因为编排器可以让 Neon 指挥一群子 agent，更快也更省钱。
作者用“用 Three.js 生成一匹逼真的 3D 马”做了一次非正式测试。Neon 比其他旗舰模型快很多，结果也比几周前的 Argon 明显进步，并且修掉了 Argon 上那个不当的内容问题。但他认为它在“马”这个项目上仍落后于 Anthropic，GPT 6.2 Astra 虽然被骂，画出的马却比 Gemini 的更逼真，只是耗时更久。这只是作者的一次试用，不是系统评测。
Gemini 4 的命名像元素周期表，让人难以跟上。Gemini 4 在 9 月以 Argon 开头，作者不清楚这个模型后来怎样了。Google 在这次发布里说，Neon 仍是大多数软件工程和知识工作的理想选择，所以作者判断 Argon 会被 Google 放弃。
points_en: Neon is a mid-tier model for coding agents, knowledge work and science, adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon. It takes text, images, audio and video, has a 1 million token context window, and costs about $3 per million input tokens and $15 for output. A cyber version exists only for trusted cyber defenders. The video also says Neon is the most expensive model in the Gemini 4 lineup until December 1st.

The benchmark results are strong, but the author stresses that they are chosen by Google. On the Artificial Analysis intelligence index Neon scores 61, one point above Carbon and third overall behind Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT 6.2 Astra. On the coding agent index it beats Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 at roughly half the cost. It also ranks first on a very hard Riemann-related math benchmark. The model card's comparison table includes only Opus 5.5 and GPT 6.2 Soul, which Neon happens to beat, and leaves out Fable and Astra. The author adds that the Riemann hypothesis was reportedly proved on Friday by Anthropic's Claude, not Neon. That proof awaits verification and competes with a human proof.

Speed results are mixed. Neon streams about 106 tokens per second, nearly twice as fast as Carbon. Artificial Analysis still labels it extremely slow, and it used 283 million tokens in their test, more than four times the median. In the author's own experience Neon is much faster than most other models. He recommends using it in Google's Antigravity IDE, where the orchestrator can direct a swarm of sub-agents with Neon, which is faster and cheaper.

The author ran an informal test: generate a realistic 3D horse with Three.js. Neon finished much faster than the other flagship models he has tried, and the result is a clear improvement over Argon from a few weeks ago. It also fixed an inappropriate content problem that Argon had. He still rates it behind Anthropic on this task. GPT 6.2 Astra was widely criticised, yet it produced a more realistic horse than Gemini, though it took longer. This is one personal trial, not a systematic evaluation.

The Gemini 4 model names are hard to follow, like a periodic table. Gemini 4 began in September with Argon, and the author does not know what happened to it. Google says in this release that Neon remains the ideal choice for most software engineering and knowledge work, so the author concludes that Argon is headed for the Google graveyard.
